articles.title: Unusual iron in Chang’e-6 soil could record ancient lunar magnetism
articles.summary: Researchers identified gamma iron in natural lunar samples for the first time. Tests suggest some particles could preserve magnetic information, but their value as records of the Moon’s past needs further study.

articles.title: Kelvin waves can raise West Coast sea levels and increase erosion risks
articles.summary: An AP report forecasts six-inch-to-one-foot sea-level increases as Kelvin waves move north along the US West Coast. These broad water bulges could increase flooding and beach erosion alongside storms and high tides.

articles.title: Looped boat propellers are being tested to reduce noise that can disrupt whales
articles.summary: Sharrow Marine says its looped propellers reduce underwater noise, including at frequencies used by whales. It is working with Ocean Alliance to test the design near whales, with animal benefits still uncertain.
